goal: Prevent a persistent crash loop on startup during AssumeUTXO background sync
Ensure nodes can restart cleanly when blocks arrive out of order without needing a full reindex
agreement: Substantive support after reproducing the crash and verifying the fix (ValeraFinebits, Yudis-bit)
Question on null block pointers in test setups was resolved (Yudis-bit)
Test hang during node restart was resolved in a rebase (cyb3ralbert)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes an unrecoverable startup crash loop during AssumeUTXO background sync
Without the fix, nodes encountering this state cannot start without wiping the snapshot chainstate
